text: Here, inside what appears to be a modern building with clean lines, glass, and quiet anticipation, I feel a curious blend of displacement and intrigue. The slight tilt in the world around me mirrors my inner sense of seeking orientation—a small jolt to my normal perception. The prospect of discovery draws me in; I am keenly attuned to the sterile promise of new knowledge and unexpected connections in this institutional setting. Safety and order permeate, but so does the sense that something new waits just beyond the transparent barrier.
